finalText:
It's building clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `retryCount`. That crashed the build.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as an error. The new config loader leaves it as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw.

Fixed both: `resolveRetries` now reads `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` treats `undefined` the same as `false`. The rest was just deprecation warnings from the bump, harmless. Build now finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
